:::{#def-graph}
#### Graph of a function

The **graph**
[@wikipedia_graph_of_a_function]
of a [function](#def-function) $f : A \to B$
is the set of [ordered pairs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-ordered-pair) $(a, f(a))$, one for each element $a$ of its domain:

$$\set{(a, f(a)) : a \in A}$$

:::
